verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say users can set up two-factor authentication in the account console, and the admin guide covers WebAuthn used together with two-factor. However, the pack never names TOTP authenticator apps, never mentions backup or recovery codes, and never describes step-up enforcement or admin-mandated MFA. missing for 10: explicit TOTP authenticator app support, backup/recovery codes, step-up authentication enforcement, documented admin ability to require MFA, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can require multi-factor authentication with TOTP authenticator apps and backup codes, with step-up enforcement where needed

citations.quote: They can update the profile, change passwords, and setup two-factor authentication.
you can manage your account including modifying your profile, adding two-factor authentication
